scope: Generic application dimensions and aggregated engineering results. Research inputs, manuscript details and raw outputs are excluded.

cases.residual_count_definition: total released in the situation, not simultaneous occupancy

memory.method: launcher samples current process WorkingSet64 and PrivateMemorySize64 every approximately 2 seconds, retaining maxima; these are sampled peaks, not OS lifetime PeakWorkingSet64
memory.warning: Measured whole historical engine; no F-off paired production memory measurement. Historical SourceGroupBuffer lazily stores SG >100 whereas PR64 uses dense double leaves.

current_PR64_memory_projection.excludes: array/reference overhead, GC retention and unchanged arrays
current_PR64_memory_projection.denominator_warning: Scale comparison only; different memory representations prevent treating it as a measured overhead fraction.

source_counts.interpretation: input rows repeat spatial geometry across release-hour source groups; do not call 213788 distinct geographical emission sources or ships

historical_precision.metric: For each situation, select whole-domain cells at or above the 99th percentile of positive concentrations in that configuration's 8k fresh-emission field. Divide the 30k concentration sum by the 8k sum over those same selected cells.

scope.selection: each configuration uses its own 8k hotspot sets

historical_precision.attribution: Historical F+S+late-NaNGuard bundle; motivation and convergence evidence, not a measured effect size for current PR #64.
do_not_claim: The historical six-situation effect size was reproduced on current PR #64.
All numbers are from an F-only run.
The stock and patched hotspot sets are identical.

historical_optimization.scope: Existing application runs, full OPT1 engine plus launcher versus the preceding patched engine plus launcher; not an isolated test of PR #68 or #69.

conditions.matching: Same physical machine and same seed within each timing pair.

concentration.metric: Area-weighted absolute concentration difference summed over the assessed land cells and times, divided by the reference concentration sum, in percent.

historical_optimization.attribution: The full package includes optimizations absent from the current two PRs, including per-worker concentration buffering. Current #69 also omits the historical hinted-search algorithm. Historical NP8 combined stack storage and slice changes; its measured single-thread whole-model effect was within timing noise. These package results cannot be assigned to either PR.
